entries.effect: fills count bytes at bytes from SecRandomCopyBytes(kSecRandomDefault), the release's own generator; a count of 0 answers kCCSuccess whatever the pointer; a NULL pointer with a count above 0 answers kCCParamError; a failure of the generator answers kCCRNGFailure; the bytes are not compared with any other generator
entries.source: the declaration in the CommonCrypto header of the SDK (CommonRandom.h, CommonCryptoError.h: kCCSuccess 0, kCCParamError -4300, kCCRNGFailure -4307); the host's CCRandomGenerateBytes and SecRandomCopyBytes measured on macOS in tests/backports/host/commoncrypto; the 6.1.3 cache exports SecRandomCopyBytes (Security) and CCRandomCopyBytes (libSystem), not this name
